task: Fix EPMCDME-14000: repair broken accordion expand animation in Configure & Test panel assistant blocks and fix LLM Model dropdown width to match full-width Skills dropdown.

key_reasoning.reason: Two bug fixes each touch distinct components: LLMSelector.tsx (max-w-sm removal) and Accordion.tsx (PrimeReact display:none override). Accordion.tsx is a shared component used across the codebase, triggering the shared-utility red flag that bumped scope from S to M. AssistantSetupSection.tsx also needs its own max-w-sm removals on the outer and nested accordion wrappers.

Root causes are precisely identified in the technical analysis. One open design decision exists for Bug 1: whether to remove max-w-sm unconditionally from LLMSelector or introduce a conditional prop to avoid affecting non-compact render sites. This is a minor choice, not a blocker.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from S (2) to M (3): Accordion.tsx is a shared UI utility component used across multiple features — touches core shared utilities red flag applies.
